scopeAndLimits: C performed no live database/cloud/GCS writes, role grants, schema application, Terraform apply, command deployment, PROD operation or notification.
V78 SHA256 remained unchanged. V79 business-body equivalence to V78 was reviewed by A; C reran changed runtime execution paths rather than the historical full engine suite.
Firebase crypto/revocation service verification is injected synthetic dependency; true non-superuser PostgreSQL LOGIN and business transaction effects are real local disposable execution.
Metadata guard and lost-acknowledgement/transport seams are labelled synthetic faults, not physical-network experiments.
Live DEV database remains outside C's testing. No actual live broad-role provisioning or command endpoint activation is established.

Default-ACL tests cover explicit APP and registered second-creator PUBLIC table defaults; protected column/default classification and representative future classes. Report does not claim every possible future schema/creator/privileged definer is permitted.
